name: agent-plugins
description: Opt-in codebase maps and interactive source-code learning for Codex sessions

interface.shortDescription: Map codebases and turn source flows into visual lessons.
interface.longDescription: Agent Plugins enables project-scoped lifecycle hooks for linked Markdown codebase maps and turns verified source traces into interactive local HTML lessons for deeper code comprehension.
interface.defaultPrompt: Enable codebase-map hooks for this project, navigate its map, or teach a source flow as an interactive HTML lesson.
